adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, after a successful parse it checks `if (!refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token)` and then assigns the literal string "refresh_token". Call sites then persist these parsed results into stored credentials (e.g., `Office365CalendarService` spreads `tokenResponse.data` into `o365AuthCredentials` before `prisma.credential.update`, which would overwrite a real existing refresh token if the refresh response omitted it). This is a verifiable data-corruption / credential-shape pollution issue introduced by the diff.
